releaseNotes:
What changed (Clinexia now keeps you informed by email

Invitations: when you invite staff to your organisation, Clinexia emails each person a private invitation link. The invite screen shows who was emailed. If an email can’t be delivered, you’ll still get that person’s link to share yourself.
Payment receipts: after each successful payment, you’ll receive a receipt with the amount, plan, reference and the date your plan runs until.
Plan reminders: a few days before your plan ends, we’ll send a reminder. Plans don’t renew automatically, and renewing the same plan early adds a month after your current end date, so nothing is lost.

Good to know

Emails come from Clinexia, so check your spam folder if one doesn’t arrive.
Invitation links work only for the email address they were sent to, and they expire.
Receipts and reminders start working for everyone once the web update is live, even before they update the app. Updating the app only improves the invite screen.)
